item.title: CNN, MS NOW reporters blocked from entering White House after Trump ban on 'fake news' - report
item.description: White House correspondents for CNN, MS NOW and Politico on Saturday were blocked from entering the US president's office and residence a day after President Donald Trump announced he was banning the three media outlets for what he called "fake news" coverage. News organisations and press freedom groups have slammed the move as unconstitutional. Publicado también por: France 24 - English. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.
